in_sanskrit.name: अग्निमित्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is a friend or ally of Agni, the god of fire.

in_hindi.name: अग्निमित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: Agnimitra is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the words 'Agni' and 'Mitra'. Agni is the name of the god of fire, and Mitra refers to a friend or ally. Thus, Agnimitra can be translated as 'Friend of Agni' or 'One who is a friend or ally of Agni'.

in_tamil.name: அக்னிமித்ர
in_tamil.long_meaning: Agnimitra is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the words 'Agni' and 'Mitram' in Tamil. Agni is the name of the god of fire, and Mitram refers to a friend or ally. Thus, Agnimitra can be translated as 'Friend of Agni' or 'One who is a friend or ally of Agni' in Tamil as well.

in_telugu.name: ఆగ్నిమిథ్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: Agnimitra is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the words 'Agni' and 'Mithramu' in Telugu. Agni is the name of the god of fire, and Mithramu refers to a friend or ally. Thus, Agnimitra can be translated as 'Friend of Agni' or 'One who is a friend or ally of Agni' in Telugu as well.

in_marathi.name: Agnimitra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agnimitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agni Mitra: One who is a friend to the fire god Agni. Agni is the god of fire and the guardian of the sacrificial fire. Mitra is a deity of friendship, contracts, and covenants.
